title: Impassive
summary: IMPAS'SIVE, adjective [Latin in and passus, patior, to suffer.] Not susceptible of pain or suffering; as the impassive air; impassive ice.

inlines.v: IMPAS'SIVE, adjective [Latin in and passus, patior, to suffer.] Not susceptible of pain or suffering; as the impassive air; impassive ice.
